title: Atoms of Compacta on Closed Surfaces
summary: For any compact set $K$ lying on a closed surface $\mathcal{S}$ we introduce a closed equivalence relation $\sim$, called the {\em Schönflies equivalence} on $K$. We show that every class $[x]_\sim$ of $\sim$ is a continuum and that the resulting quotient space $K\!/\!\sim$ is a {\em Peano compactum}. By definition, all components of a Peano compactum are locally connected and for any $\varepsilon>0$ only finitely many of them have diameter greater than $\varepsilon$.
